topic: Side point: the chapter 74 to 76 knife scene, where Nami hurt only herself to protect Usopp
title: Nami's Glove Hides Arlong Park's Biggest Twist
description: Nami's glove in One Piece Arlong Park hides a twist most fans forget: chapter 74 looks cruel, chapter 76 shows who she really hurt. Is her secrecy her biggest strength or her biggest flaw?
comment: Is Nami's secrecy her biggest strength or her biggest flaw?

lines.text: Nami's glove in Arlong Park hides the bravest thing she ever does.

shot.fallback: orange haired navigator pulling on a glove

lines.text: In chapter 74, she corners Usopp with a knife in front of the whole fishman crew.

shot.fallback: navigator holding a knife before a sniper

lines.text: So she kicks Usopp into the sea, and the chapter ends there.
Two chapters later, chapter 76 shows what really happened. Usopp only fainted.
The knife went into Nami's own hand instead.
Here's the part most people forget. She wears that glove until the truth comes out.
Johnny sees the scene from far away and believes every word, so the lie works on everyone.
She chose herself as the price so Usopp wouldn't have to pay it.

shot.fallback: navigator stepping in front of a sniper

lines.text: That's the habit I can't unsee. Nami takes the hit privately and the crew finds out later.

shot.search: Nami Straw Hats Arlong Park hit

lines.text: Hold onto that habit, because one Straw Hat just got the opposite lesson.
Which is why that glove hides the bravest thing she ever does.
